mapper.select: SELECT ci.checklist_item_id, ci.performance_project_id, ci.performance_round_id, ci.team_id, ci.scope_code, ci.content, ci.is_required, ci.display_order, ci.is_completed, ci.completed_by_member_id, ci.completed_dttm, ci.created_by_member_id, ci.updated_by_member_id, ci.created_dttm, ci.updated_dttm, ci.deleted_dttm FROM checklist_item ci WHERE ci.checklist_item_id = #{checklistItemId} AND FOR UPDATE

SELECT cih.checklist_item_history_id, cih.checklist_item_id, cih.previous_completed, cih.new_completed, cih.changed_by_member_id, m.name AS changed_by_member_name, cih.changed_dttm, cih.reason FROM checklist_item_history cih JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cih.changed_by_member_id WHERE cih.checklist_item_id = #{checklistItemId} ORDER BY cih.changed_dttm DESC, cih.checklist_item_history_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checklist_item ( performance_project_id, performance_round_id, team_id, scope_code, content, is_required, display_order, is_completed, completed_by_member_id, completed_dttm, created_by_member_id, updated_by_member_id ) VALUES ( #{performanceProjectId}, #{performanceRoundId}, #{teamId}, #{scope}, #{content}, #{required}, #{displayOrder}, #{completed}, #{completedByMemberId}, #{completedDttm}, #{createdByMemberId}, #{updatedByMemberId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE checklist_item SET content = #{content}, is_required = #{required}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, is_completed = #{completed}, completed_by_member_id = #{completedByMemberId}, completed_dttm = #{completedDttm}, updated_by_member_id = #{updatedByMemberId} WHERE checklist_item_id = #{checklistItemId} AND deleted_dttm IS NULL
